_: The epithet inventory: the recipes every translated name is made from. An entry names one kind of thing (about: civ, star, elder, makers, plague, title, war, word, source) in the tones listed, and is allowed only where every property in requires holds of the thing as the namer knows it at the coining year (a leading ! negates); the pattern's holes are filled from slots: bank:<field> draws a word of data/banks.json by the hash of the name, and any other value is a property of the thing (self, home, cradle, them, deed.star, host, host.star, star, enemy, work, first, last, mark, form, onset), a name token where it names a thing. notice lists the semantic fields the pattern leans on; the namer's weight per field comes from the notice table, by its senses, its world and its organisation, and multiplies the entry's weight. The pass scores the entries whose requirements hold, keeps the top six, and draws one by score. A people's name carries no article (the view says 'the'); every other name carries its own.

What a namer knows: kind and voice from any meeting; body and world from a meeting in the flesh or an understanding; ways and fixation from an understanding or a war; every deed between the two before the coining (deed: what they did to us, did: what we did to them, bond: what we did together, warcause: why the war came); of a star its class, company and what the namer did there (place); of a remain its kind, its work and its look; of a plague its profile and the host it came from. properties lists the ones the floor test counts: each must be required by at least eight entries across the tones.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.
